tools.name: get_leave_balance
tools.title: Get leave balance
tools.description: Returns the signed-in employee's current annual leave and personal leave balance for this financial year: opening balance, entitlement, days taken, days pending approval and days available.

leaveType.description: Which balance to return. Defaults to all.

tools.name: get_working_days
tools.title: Get working days for a financial year
tools.description: Counts the signed-in employee's working days in an Australian financial year (1 July - 30 June) for tax purposes, e.g. to support a work-from-home deduction. Working days = weekdays - public holidays - approved leave. Current financial year is counted up to today.

financialYear.description: Financial year in the form 2025-26. Defaults to the most recently completed financial year.
